# probity-verify

> Offline verifier that decides supported, contradicted or not_established for a claim against consumer-pinned evidence bytes.

## Docs

- [Install a pinned version](https://github.com/probityai/probity-verify/blob/main/docs/install.md): published package and matching source inputs, separate environment, three sample decisions and error behavior
- [Choose a claim check](https://github.com/probityai/probity-verify/blob/main/docs/recipes.md): task selector for the registered adapters
- [Checked recipe index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/probityai/probity-verify/main/docs/recipes.json): exact argument arrays, source-checkout fixtures, package-name availability, expected outcomes, scope and input digests
- [Running the verifier](https://github.com/probityai/probity-verify/blob/main/docs/running.md): commands, inputs, decisions
- [Replayable decisions and the index](https://github.com/probityai/probity-verify/blob/main/docs/bundles-and-index.md): bundles, replay, disputes
- [Select a consumer adapter](https://github.com/probityai/probity-verify/blob/main/docs/adapter-api.md): explicit per-call versions through adjudication and bundles
- [Check a customer offer](https://github.com/probityai/probity-verify/blob/main/docs/customer-support-action.md): raw records, exact approvals and portable replay
- [Adapters](https://github.com/probityai/probity-verify/blob/main/docs/adapters.md): operand lineage, authority anchor, event absence
- [Done-receipt checks](https://github.com/probityai/probity-verify/blob/main/docs/done-receipt.md): protected paths, outside acceptance grade, claimed command runs, witness scope
- [Adapter plan](https://github.com/probityai/probity-verify/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): architecture
- [Source coverage vectors](https://github.com/probityai/probity-verify/blob/main/vectors-source-coverage/README.md)
- [Operand-lineage vectors](https://github.com/probityai/probity-verify/blob/main/vectors-operand-lineage/README.md)
